title: Do Commercial Ties Influence ESG Ratings? Evidence from Moody’s and S&P

scopes.description: Complete supplied workflow: 11 ordered SAS data-preparation/table stages, including the Step 3 firm-matching step, followed by the supplied Stata table analyses and all seven matching SAS-to-Stata dataset handoffs.

requirements.description: Reviewed firm-name crosswalk imported from Fuzzy_Checked.xlsx to link unmatched Moody ESG vigeokey values to Moody credit MAST_ISSR_NUM values. The included Identifier.xlsx (event, isin) is not the named crosswalk and does not establish this mapping.

Monthly ESG and firm identity: vigeokey, produceddate, globalscore, ISIN, country, title and LEI. Code forms 2016–2021 month ends, carries the latest produceddate at or before each month end, then averages globalscore by firm and year. The same identifiers feed the Moody credit match.

Annual company records keyed by ITEM6105 and matched by ISIN ITEM6008; code requires year_, Freq="A", ITEM5350 date and nonmissing ITEM2999, then uses ITEM7230, ITEM3501, ITEM2501, ITEM3255, ITEM18191, ITEM8631, ITEM1201, ITEM2001 and ITEM4551 for controls. ESG year joins to the prior fiscal year; the authored panel is 2016–2021.

routes.description: Worldscope annual candidate has the probed ITEM fields used by the supplied financial-control joins. Row readability and selected columns are verified; firm-year coverage/history is not. Target mapping: ITEM6008/ITEM6105 keys, ITEM5350 fiscal date, year_/Freq controls and selected ITEM fundamentals.

requirements.description: ITEM6105 and year_ link the stock record to annual fundamentals; ITEM8002 supplies same-year market capitalization for Tobin Q.

routes.description: Worldscope stock candidate has the probed key/year and ITEM8002 fields. Target mapping: ITEM6105/year_ to annual fundamentals; history is unverified.

requirements.description: ITEM6105 links company records; ITEM6026 supplies the Worldscope country and ITEM7021 the industry for the ESG firm-year panel.

routes.description: Worldscope company candidate has the probed ITEM6105, ITEM6026 and ITEM7021 fields used for country/industry links; coverage is unverified.

requirements.description: Code joins ITEM6038 to ticker, counts distinct analys by anndats year, and uses the year before each ESG firm-year. This is the international detail panel, separate from the US table.

routes.description: International I/B/E/S detail candidate has TICKER, ANALYS and ANNDATS in a readable one-row sample. It is a candidate for the authored ticker/year analyst count; history and market coverage remain unverified.

requirements.description: Code joins ITEM6038 to ticker, counts distinct analys by anndats year, and uses the year before each ESG firm-year. This is the US detail panel, separate from the international table.

routes.description: US I/B/E/S detail candidate has TICKER, ANALYS and ANNDATS in a readable one-row sample. It is a candidate for the authored ticker/year analyst count; history and market coverage remain unverified.

requirements.description: Code needs ISIN, quarter and io; derives year from quarter/100 and averages ownership by ISIN in the year before each ESG observation.
Code needs isin, companyid, startdate and enddate. It matches ESG years and bond/green-bond issue dates only within the identifier interval.

routes.description: Capital IQ candidate has companyid, isin, startdate and enddate in a readable one-row sample; the supplied interval join can be prepared from these source fields. Historical coverage is not verified.

requirements.description: Code needs cid, year and ESG, plus country and ticker for Worldscope linking. It creates 2016–2021 firm-year rows and merges source ESG by cid and year.
Code maps the S&P country field to Worldscope ITEM6026 and adjusts S&P tickers for the specified country formats before joining annual fundamentals.

Code needs MAST_ISSR_NUM, RATG_DATETIME, RATG_EXPIRE_DATETIME and ISSR_RATG_TXT. It carries active ratings into a 2011–2021 issuer-year panel and uses the latest valid issuer rating at bond issue date.
Code needs MAST_DEBT_NUM, RATG_CLSS_NUM, RATG_DATETIME, RATG_END_DATETIME and RATG_TXT; it counts valid ratings by issuer/security/class over the 2011–2021 panel.
Code joins by MAST_DEBT_NUM to add MAST_ISSR_NUM and, for bond records, uses FIRST_LT_RATG.
Code joins MAST_ISSR_NUM to ISSUER_NAM and MDY_DOMN_NUM when assembling the credit-firm list.
Code joins MDY_DOMN_NUM to DOMN_NAM for the issuer country used in matching and panel construction.
Code joins MAST_ISSR_NUM to ISSR_ID, filtered to ISSR_ID_NUM="LEI", to match Moody ESG firms through LEI before the reviewed crosswalk.

Code needs company_id, ratingtypecode, ratingdate, ratingtime and ratingsymbol, carries rating intervals through 2011–2021 and uses STDLONG issuer ratings at bond issue date. A local CIQ issuer-rating table is only a candidate because product/version and history are not established.

routes.description: CIQ issuer-rating candidate has company_id, ratingtypecode, ratingdate, ratingtime and ratingsymbol in a readable sample. This is a field-aligned candidate for the S&P issuer-rating input; vendor/version semantics, STDLONG category coverage and history are unverified.

requirements.description: Code needs companyid and security_id to link each S&P ESG firm to security-level ratings. The exact entity/security link table was not matched in the catalog.
Code needs security_id, ratingtypecode, ratingdate, ratingtime and ratingsymbol, constructs validity intervals and counts non-NR security ratings by firm-year.

Code joins isin and fyear to ESGCombinedScore in the same firm-year. TRESG.WRDS_ESG_CATSCORES has a readable Score/FisYear/FeedDate/OrgID candidate and TRESG.WRDS_COMPANY_INFO has OrgID/Isin, but the catalog and one-row checks do not establish that Score is the required ESGCombinedScore or verify year coverage.

routes.description: TRESG ESG candidate exposes OrgID, FisYear, FeedDate, FYEndDate and Score. It does not expose the code’s ESGCombinedScore name; Score meaning and the OrgID-to-ISIN join remain unverified.
TRESG company-info candidate exposes OrgID and Isin in a readable sample, potentially pairing with the ESG score table; exact source compatibility and coverage remain unverified.

requirements.description: Code needs ISSUERID, ISSUER_ISIN, AS_OF_DATE and weighted_average_score; links issuer ISIN and averages the score by year for the matched firms. KLD.HISTORY is not an equivalent overall-score field map.
Code needs CapitalIQ_ID, date and total_esg_score; extracts the company identifier from CapitalIQ_ID and averages ratings by year.
Code needs EntityId and isin to connect the provider risk series to matched ESG firms.
Code needs EntityId, file_date and ESG_Risk_Score; averages within year, reverses score sign, and coalesces with the ratings series for the matched year.
Code needs FSYM_ID, price_date, price and shares_outstanding, retains the latest observation in each firm-quarter, and joins the prior quarter to calculate turnover.
Code needs factset_entity_id, FSYM_ID, quarter, io and isin; aligns current and prior-quarter holdings and computes the 2014–2018 institutional turnover measure.
Code needs isin, year and esgdiscscore; averages the pre-event 2014–2018 disclosure score.
Code needs ISIN, IssueDate, green-issue identification and bond_amount for 2016–2021, then maps companyid through dated Capital IQ ISIN intervals and computes pre/post counts and amounts.

Code needs Bond_ID, Issuer, IssueDate, ISIN, Country, Industry, Bond_Amount, Bond_Yield and Bond_Maturity for 2016–2021; it joins security/issuer ratings and firm-year treatment, then excludes Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac. SDC.WRDS_NI_DETAILS is a local new-issue candidate whose differently named deal/tranche, date, principal, yield, maturity, name, ISIN, nation and industry fields need an explicit contract and tranche mapping.

routes.description: SDC new-issue candidate is readable and exposes MASTER_DEAL_NO, TRANCHE_ID, MASTER_DEAL_DATE, NINAMES, PRINCIPALAMOUNT, YIELD, FINALMATURITY, ISIN, NATION and INDUSTRY. Target mapping requires an explicit deal/tranche identifier choice and renaming to the supplied Bond_ID/Issuer/IssueDate/Bond_Amount/Bond_Yield/Bond_Maturity/Country fields; coverage is unverified.

requirements.description: Code needs ID_NUM, ID_NUM_CD and MAST_DEBT_NUM, filters ID_NUM_CD="ISI", and maps bond ISIN to Moody debt identifiers.
Code needs isin and security_id to match bond ISINs to S&P security ratings.
Code needs isin and FSYM_ID to start the provider-specific identifier chain.
Code needs FSYM_ID, FACTSET_ENTITY_ID, START_DATE and END_DATE to construct the valid entity interval.
Code needs FACTSET_ID and PROVIDER_ID to map FactSet entity identifiers to TV_ORG_ID.
Code needs TV_ORG_ID, TV_DATE and INSIGHT_SCORE; it joins within identifier validity intervals, uses the future year, and averages only years with at least 180 scored days.
Code needs TV_ORG_ID, TV_DATE and ARTICLE_VOLUME, matched to the insight record and screened at a minimum of five articles before annual scoring.

Code needs reprisk_id, incident_date and severity, classifies severity 2 or 3 as severe and joins the future year to the matched firm panel. The RepRisk V2 incident table has matching field names, but coverage/version compatibility remains unverified.

routes.description: RepRisk V2 incident candidate exposes reprisk_id, incident_date and severity in a readable sample, matching the supplied incident fields. Severity coding/version and future-year historical coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: Code needs primary_isin and reprisk_id to join matched firm ISINs to incident records. The RepRisk V2 company identifiers candidate exposes these names; history and coverage are unverified.

routes.description: RepRisk V2 company-identifier candidate exposes reprisk_id and primary_isin in a readable sample, matching the supplied link fields; population/history are unverified.

requirements.description: Code needs companyid, fiscalyear, S1, S2, S3_Up and S3_Down, then joins the following fiscal year. Local TRUCOST.WRDS_COMPANIES exposes institutionid/companyid and WRDS_ENVIRONMENT exposes institutionid/fiscalyear/periodenddate plus coded di_* fields; the source-category definitions and mapping to all four code inputs remain unverified.

routes.description: Trucost environment candidate exposes institutionid, fiscalyear, periodenddate and coded di_* fields. It is a local product candidate, but the four supplied S1/S2/S3_Up/S3_Down definitions and code-to-item mapping are not established.
Trucost company candidate exposes institutionid and companyid in a readable sample, which may support the author input firm key after field mapping; identifier population/history are unverified.

issues.description: The supplied workflow reads 39 external product tables plus Fuzzy_Checked.xlsx. Exact frozen-catalog searches and selected one-row local checks find usable candidates for some Worldscope/IBES/Capital IQ/SDC/Refinitiv ESG/RepRisk/Trucost components, but do not verify full source-field meanings, identifiers, product versions or historical coverage. Several named families have no compatible frozen-catalog candidate. The package contains no SAS input panels; candidate mappings and 2011–2021 credit / 2014–2018 pre-period / 2016–2021 ESG windows remain unverified.

Step 3 exports unmatched ESG and credit firm lists, imports Fuzzy_Checked.xlsx and uses reviewed mappings to create output.step32. The named workbook is absent from the package. A SAS source comment locates a Python fuzzy-match step in a log, but the unread log does not establish its contents; the actual matching/review provenance and imported sheet contract remain unresolved. The separately supplied Identifier.xlsx is a bounded one-row event/isin file, not a supported substitute.

Stata 18, reghdfe and ebalance are captured available. outreg2 and ttable3 were not found in the checked Stata lookup paths; the supplied workflow also needs SAS, whose registered status remains unverified. These are setup/verification tasks, not evidence of an access barrier.

The supplied SAS block imports Fuzzy_Checked.xlsx with DBMS=EXCEL and requests Sheet1$, GETNAMES=YES, MIXED=NO, SCANTEXT=YES, USEDATE=YES and SCANTIME=YES. The official SAS/ACCESS 9.4 reference lists the EXCEL engine on Microsoft Windows and documents direct XLSX handling under UNIX. For Linux SAS, prepare a supported route for the same reviewed workbook or use a compatible Windows/PC Files Server environment; check the workbook sheet, headers, types and only options supported by the selected route. The workbook and SAS/ACCESS capability remain unknown, and no import or source edit was tested.

	a.*, b.year_, b.freq, b.ITEM6105, b.ITEM6008, b.ITEM6038, b.ITEM5601, b.ITEM6004, b.ITEM5350, b.ITEM2999,
